segments.text: Here's my honest problem with this book. It brilliantly diagnoses every glitch in your thinking.
It shows you the anchoring, the loss aversion, the biases running your decisions. The diagnosis is world-class.
But the prescription is thin. Knowing about a bias barely helps. You walk right into it anyway, even after the chapter.
The real fix isn't awareness, it's rules. A checklist, a formula, a system that decides when your gut can't be trusted.
Great book. Read it for the diagnosis. Full verdict on the channel.
